catalogue_gaps.myth_fields: none: no fact sheet in data/fact_sheets or data/script_library carries a cards.myths entry (refuting_fact_id appears in no JSON file in the repository). A real myth-vs-fact card cannot be rendered from existing inputs.
catalogue_gaps.statement_fields: one: data/fact_sheets/hal_saflieni_hypogeum.json cards.statements S1, check verdict 'needs_check' with no runs and no signature, so card_fields.verify_field refuses it.
catalogue_gaps.gated_titles: every run's fact_review holds only public_fingerprint / sheet_path / sheet_sha256 / review_rules_fingerprint, with no check record, so design_cards.gated_text refuses Gated('title'|'youtube_title') on every run (fact_evidence.checked_fact_review: no current check record).
catalogue_gaps.consequence: Every hook, chapter and myth card needs a checked, signed card field. None exists. The real inputs are the fact sheets' facts, the runs' titles, act titles and hero photos below; the card fields themselves must be produced by fact_sheet.build + card_fields.check_cards (with a checker key) before a card can be rendered honestly. Anything rendered before that is new and must be labelled.
